title: Design System: EMO open server admin

display.purpose: View title at the top of the sheet; 2.5rem on phones.

headline.purpose: Product name in the name bar on the board.

lede.purpose: One-line explanation under the view title; max 68ch.

book.purpose: Notes, plate details, results, what EMO heard; max 68ch.

body.purpose: Controls and default text, tabular numerals.

slip.purpose: Vermilion problem slip; table heads use the same voice at 0.82rem.

shadows.name: sheet-lift
shadows.purpose: The sheet lying on the board; the only lifted surface.

shadows.name: tab-edge
shadows.purpose: Card-stock edge under each desktop rail tab.

shadows.name: tab-tuck
shadows.purpose: Phone tabs not current, tucked behind the sheet.

motion.name: board-recolour
motion.purpose: Board takes the new section hue in a two-frame step, no easing.

motion.name: sheet-hinge
motion.purpose: Sheet nudges back into place on section change.

constraints: Strict CSP: inline CSS and JS only; no web fonts, images or external hosts. Type stacks are system stacks and icons are inline SVG.
Open follow-up: a self-hosted condensed display face needs a verified licence and the owner's sign-off before entering the tree, and must be inlined.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Default action: ink block with sheet-coloured text.
components.css: .ds-btn { font:600 16px/1.5 system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,"Noto Sans",sans-serif; min-height:44px; padding:9px 12px; border:1px solid; border-radius:6px; cursor:pointer; background:var(--ink, #15171a); color:var(--sheet, #fbfcfd); border-color:var(--ink, #15171a); } .ds-btn:hover { filter:brightness(1.15); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--ink, #15171a); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-btn:disabled { opacity:.5; cursor:default; filter:none; }

components.name: Plain Button
components.description: Secondary action: transparent with a hairline border.
components.css: .ds-btn-plain { font:600 16px/1.5 system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,"Noto Sans",sans-serif; min-height:44px; padding:9px 12px; border:1px solid; border-radius:6px; cursor:pointer; background:transparent; color:var(--ink, #15171a); border-color:var(--edge, #d3d8df); } .ds-btn-plain:hover { border-color:var(--ink, #15171a); } .ds-btn-plain:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--ink, #15171a); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Danger Button (alone)
components.description: Destructive action, pushed to the far end of its row with 32px of empty space before it.
components.css: .ds-row { display:flex; gap:10px; align-items:flex-end; } .ds-btn-plain { font:600 16px/1.5 system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,"Noto Sans",sans-serif; min-height:44px; padding:9px 12px; border:1px solid; border-radius:6px; cursor:pointer; background:transparent; color:var(--ink, #15171a); border-color:var(--edge, #d3d8df); } .ds-btn-danger { font:600 16px/1.5 system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,"Noto Sans",sans-serif; min-height:44px; padding:9px 12px; border:1px solid; border-radius:6px; cursor:pointer; background:transparent; color:var(--problem-ink, #a51d16); border-color:var(--problem-ink, #a51d16); margin-left:auto; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { filter:brightness(1.15); } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--ink, #15171a); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Labelled field; focus turns the border ink and rings it in the section hue.
components.html: <label class="ds-label" for="ds-f">Say something to EMO (typed)</label><input class="ds-input" id="ds-f" type="text" placeholder="set a timer for ten minutes">
components.css: .ds-label { display:block; color:var(--ink-2, #4a4f57); font:600 .86rem/1.5 system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,"Noto Sans",sans-serif; margin:.7rem 0 .2rem; } .ds-input { font:16px/1.5 system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,"Noto Sans",sans-serif; width:100%; max-width:600px; min-height:44px; padding:9px 12px; border:1px solid var(--edge, #d3d8df); border-radius:6px; background:var(--field, #ffffff); color:var(--ink, #15171a); } .ds-input::placeholder { color:var(--ink-2, #4a4f57); opacity:.8; } .ds-input:focus { border-color:var(--ink, #15171a); outline:2px solid var(--hue, #f2c230); outline-offset:0; }

components.name: Tab Rail
components.description: Section tabs in full-strength hues with a punched hole; the current tab reaches full width.
components.css: .ds-rail { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:5px; width:172px; } .ds-tab { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:9px; width:84%; min-height:48px; padding:0 14px 0 16px; border:0; border-radius:0 8px 8px 0; font:600 .98rem/1.1 "Univers Condensed","Helvetica Neue Condensed","Arial Narrow","Roboto Condensed","DejaVu Sans Condensed","Liberation Sans Narrow","Nimbus Sans Narrow",system-ui,sans-serif; font-stretch:condensed; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.05em; text-align:left; cursor:pointer; box-shadow:0 2px 1px rgba(0,0,0,.2); } .ds-tab:hover { width:90%; } .ds-tab[aria-current=page] { width:100%; font-weight:700; } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #15171a; outline-offset:2px; } .ds-hole { width:9px; height:9px; border-radius:50%; box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1.5px currentColor; opacity:.7; } .ds-tab[aria-current=page] .ds-hole { background:currentColor; opacity:1; } .ds-home { background:#f2c230; color:#15171a; } .ds-setup { background:#8c4a2b; color:#fff; } .ds-try { background:#e06a1f; color:#15171a; } .ds-act { background:#239494; color:#15171a; } .ds-exp { background:#6b3fa0; color:#fff; } .ds-gap { margin-top:22px; }

components.name: Key Pill
components.description: Round hairline tag beside an API-key label.

components.name: Problem Slip
components.description: Vermilion condensed-caps tag; the only filled vermilion on the sheet besides the error toast.
components.css: .ds-slip { display:inline-block; background:var(--problem, #d7261e); color:#fff; font:700 .78rem/1 "Univers Condensed","Helvetica Neue Condensed","Arial Narrow","Roboto Condensed","DejaVu Sans Condensed","Liberation Sans Narrow","Nimbus Sans Narrow",system-ui,sans-serif; font-stretch:condensed; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.06em; padding:4px 7px; border-radius:3px; }

components.css: .ds-engines { list-style:none; margin:0; padding:0; } .ds-engines li { display:grid; grid-template-columns:auto minmax(0,1fr) auto; gap:4px 14px; align-items:center; padding:14px 16px; border:1px solid var(--edge, #d3d8df); border-radius:6px; background:var(--field, #ffffff); color:var(--ink, #15171a); } .ds-plate { font:700 1.02rem/1 "Univers Condensed","Helvetica Neue Condensed","Arial Narrow","Roboto Condensed","DejaVu Sans Condensed","Liberation Sans Narrow","Nimbus Sans Narrow",system-ui,sans-serif; font-stretch:condensed; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.08em; background:var(--ink, #15171a); color:var(--sheet, #fbfcfd); padding:7px 10px 6px; border-radius:3px; min-width:7.5rem; text-align:center; } .ds-uses { font:1.05rem/1.3 "Iowan Old Style","Charter","Bitstream Charter","Sitka Text",Cambria,"DejaVu Serif",Georgia,serif; } .ds-state { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; font:.9rem system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,"Noto Sans",sans-serif; color:var(--ink-2, #4a4f57); } .ds-mark { width:18px; height:18px; color:var(--ink, #15171a); }

components.name: Stage Timing Bar
components.description: Where a reply's time went, in ink textures against the dashed 10 s listening window; overrun in vermilion.
components.css: .ds-tbar { position:relative; height:12px; margin:9px 0 3px; background:var(--edge-2, #e9ecf0); border-radius:2px; max-width:560px; } .ds-tbar span { position:absolute; top:0; bottom:0; } .ds-stt { background:var(--ink, #15171a); } .ds-llm { background:repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, var(--ink, #15171a) 0 3px, transparent 3px 6px); box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--ink, #15171a); } .ds-tts { background:var(--sheet, #fbfcfd); box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1.5px var(--ink, #15171a); } .ds-late { background:var(--problem, #d7261e); } .ds-tbar .ds-limit { top:-5px; bottom:-5px; width:0; border-left:2px dashed var(--ink, #15171a); }

narrative.overview:
The admin page is a well-made manual for one desk robot. Seven sections each own a colour tab at full strength; the tabs hang off the fore edge of a single milk-white sheet, and whichever section is open lends its colour to the whole board the sheet lies on. You always know where you are because the room itself has changed colour. Everything on the sheet is ink: black text, hairline rules, drawn state marks. Vermilion is the one other colour allowed on the sheet, and it means something is wrong.

Density is that of a printed reference card, not a dashboard. Sections on the sheet are separated by rules rather than boxed, explanations are set in a book serif so they read as prose, headings and labels are condensed grotesk capitals so they read as signage, and machine values (timings, codes, commands) are set in mono. The page refuses the white-sidebar SaaS dashboard and the cartoon-robot page; it should feel like equipment documentation that someone cared about.

The page is one self-contained file served under a strict Content Security Policy: inline CSS and JS only, no web fonts, no images, no external hosts. The type stacks are therefore system stacks by design and every icon is inline SVG drawn in the page's own stroke.
keyCharacteristics: One colour per section, at full strength, used for the tab and the board; never inside the sheet's content.
Milk-white sheet (never cream) with a hairline edge, lifted off the board by a soft two-layer shadow.
Ink-only content: state is shown by drawn marks (filled check, hollow ring, vermilion cross), not by traffic-light colour.
Three voices of type: condensed caps for heads, book serif for explanations, mono for machine values.
Engines wear fixed name plates; risky buttons stand alone at the far end of their row.
Section changes hinge in a 90 ms two-step with no easing.

rules.name: The Board Rule
rules.body: A section's hue belongs to its tab and to the board. Content on the sheet never uses a section hue for meaning or decoration.

rules.name: The One Alarm Rule
rules.body: Vermilion means a problem or a destructive action, and nothing else. Healthy and waiting states are ink and graphite.

rules.name: The Three Voices Rule
rules.body: Condensed caps for anything that names, serif for anything that explains, mono for anything a machine produced. Never set a sentence of explanation in condensed caps.

rules.name: The Flat Sheet Rule
rules.body: Only the sheet, the tabs and the toasts cast shadows. Plates, inputs, buttons and blocks on the sheet are flat.

dos: **Do** give any new section its own full-strength hue, its own tab, and its own on-hue text colour chosen for contrast (ink or white).
**Do** keep sheet content in ink and graphite; show state with the drawn marks (filled check, hollow ring, vermilion cross) at 18px.
**Do** separate sections on the sheet with 1px hairline rules, not boxes.
**Do** set names and heads in condensed caps, explanations in the book serif (max 68ch), and machine values in mono.
**Do** give every engine a name plate with the role engraved in an ink label.
**Do** push destructive buttons to the far end of their row with the `alone` spacing.
**Do** keep touch targets at 44px minimum and keep both light and dark themes working.
**Do** draw icons as inline SVG in the page's own stroke weight; the CSP allows nothing else.
donts: **Don't** use a section hue inside the sheet for status, emphasis or decoration.
**Don't** use vermilion for anything but problems and destructive actions.
**Don't** use a cream or warm-tinted sheet; it is milk white.
**Don't** nest a bordered box inside another bordered box on the sheet.
**Don't** add shadows to anything on the sheet.
**Don't** add easing curves or long transitions to section changes; the hinge is 90 ms in two steps.
**Don't** load web fonts, images or anything from another host.
